text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Kikuka-sho, Royce and 
Royce was—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, horseshoes aren't loose either. One 
last time, wiping my glasses...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yo, Royce! I'm heading on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ticket-san!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting in the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Fufu! Trainer-san, I'm heading out too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, Royce is here too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm truly glad. To have every single 
one of us gathered here for the Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Unless I score a total victory over you 
all, I wouldn't be worthy of claiming the 
peak of this generation!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Besides—Umamusume grow stronger over the 
summer. Spring victories alone aren't 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat the current you guys too. With 
my own legs, I'll chase you down from 
behind and win!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I... I've been waiting for this day too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
During the Derby, I only had eyes for my 
own goal.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I understand now... It's precisely 
because we're friends that we both want to 
win."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way! I want to beat you 
all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh... Is the mood between BNW and Royce 
kind of...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"The rivalry vibe is through the roof!? 
Aaah~! The tension is palpable!"

Something felt different from usual. 
Normally, she would have tried much harder 
to prove she could fight back.
choice_data_list:
(For someone playing the hard-worker 
character, that's pretty harsh.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so excited! Or wait, is it 
thrilling?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Either way, I'm all fired uuuuuuuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hanging out together is fun and all, but 
really, competing against everyone right 
here is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I won't lose, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of losing either!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A declaration of war, is it? However, I 
will not yield this race either!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I shall take you all on with my "Winning 
Formula"!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That's just what I was hoping for!

Royce and Royce was full of life— she was 
pouring her heart into enjoying her youth 
alongside BNW.
